On a fixture the TV never locks by itself (fixtures load once), so the lock is the lock fixture loaded into a fresh copy of tv.js on the same page (eval, see PR). The join QR is drawn by the first eval (shots/tv/helper.mjs) because its library sits on cdnjs, which this container can't reach.
